label: Metadata migration to _system._mobile (Sync Gateway 4.1+)
type: the one-time, opt-in operation migrating a database's Sync Gateway internal metadata from the default collection (_default._default) into the reserved sgw:system-metadata-collection (_system._mobile), separating it from application data.
note: First contact for both this operation and its target collection - 4.1-only material, genuinely new territory even within the sgw: namespace's existing configuration vocabulary.
